name: Fernando Pailhe
summary: Senior Mobile Engineer with 5+ years building and rescuing production apps in React Native, TypeScript and Kotlin. On Techint's internal offline-first app (EQM) I restored release continuity, built a 2,000+ test suite and migrated the full core from JavaScript to TypeScript with AI agents in about a month, with zero regressions. I work agent-first: I design the context (rules, skills, knowledge bases) and the roles (planner, builder, reviewer) that make AI-assisted development reliable with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin and Claude Code, most recently to launch Tune-Up solo. A decade in audiovisual production shaped my product and UX eye.
